title: LRU cache evicts the wrong entries
prompt: This project has a small LRU cache (`src/lru.js`) with a `memoize` helper and hit statistics. Reported problems: recently read entries are still evicted first; overwriting a key that is already cached throws away another entry even though there is room; `memoize` recomputes results that are falsy (0, "", false, null) every time; and `stats().hitRate` is NaN before the first lookup (it should be 0). Find the causes and fix them. Run the tests with `npm test`.
